title: RoutineBuildStatus
description: The status of a routine build.

buildDuration.description: Output only. The time taken for the image build. Populated only after the build succeeds or fails.

buildState.description: Output only. The current build state of the routine.

buildStateUpdateTime.description: Output only. The time when the build state was updated last.

imageSizeBytes.description: Output only. The size of the image in bytes. Populated only after the build succeeds.
